comment: pickup.c query_objlist() 1058-1062 and 1185-1208: picking up from an engulfer's inventory refuses items it wears. A debug Valkyrie (monpolycontrol) drops an amulet of life saving beside a tame djinni, which puts it on, then drops her dagger, which it picks up and wields; she zaps a wand of polymorph at it and answers 'fog cloud', puts on a ring of conflict, and the fog cloud engulfs her. Inside, ',' lists the worn amulet, the dagger and a scroll; picking all three refuses the amulet ('You can't pick ... up', 1186) and shrinks the list (1204-1208). A second ',' lists only the worn amulet, so AUTOSELECT_SINGLE is cleared (1061-1062); picking it empties the list (1197-1199).
